metadata.purpose: Comprehensive System Test Cases for Documentation & Examiner Audit

testCases.title: Working Calendar Day Addition (Weekend Exclusion)
testCases.objective: Verify that date arithmetic strictly counts Monday to Friday working days and skips Saturdays and Sundays.
testCases.preconditions: Working calendar utility initialized with standard 5-day business week.
executionSteps: 1. Pass startDate '2026-11-02' and workingDays=5 to dateUtils.addWorkingDays().
3. Assert Saturday and Sunday are skipped without incrementing working day count.
testCases.expectedResult: Returns Friday '2026-11-06' (5 elapsed working days within a single business week).

testCases.title: Circular Predecessor Dependency Cycle Detection (Kahn's Algorithm)
testCases.objective: Verify that Kahn's algorithm detects circular activity dependencies (e.g., A -> B -> A) and throws a descriptive cycle error before CPM calculation.
testCases.preconditions: Schedule engine initialized with activity network.
executionSteps: 3. Assert that cycle detection triggers exception.
testCases.expectedResult: Engine detects cycle and throws error: 'Circular dependency detected in schedule network'.
testCases.actualResult: Threw Error: Circular dependency detected in schedule network: ACT-A -> ACT-B -> ACT-A

testCases.title: CPM Forward Pass, Backward Pass & Float Determination
testCases.objective: Verify Early Start (ES), Early Finish (EF), Late Start (LS), Late Finish (LF), Total Float, and Critical Path flags across a multi-path network.
testCases.preconditions: Network with activities ACT-01 (5d), ACT-02 (5d, pred: 01), ACT-03 (2d, pred: 01), ACT-04 (5d, pred: 02 & 03).
executionSteps: 1. Execute forward pass calculating ES and EF for all nodes.
2. Execute backward pass from max EF calculating LF and LS.
4. Flag activities with Total Float <= 0 as isCritical: true.
testCases.expectedResult: ACT-01, ACT-02, and ACT-04 have Total Float = 0 (Critical Path); ACT-03 has Total Float = 3 days (Non-critical).
testCases.actualResult: Critical Path identified: ACT-01 -> ACT-02 -> ACT-04 with zero float; ACT-03 float is 3 days.

testCases.title: Cascading Schedule Slippage Calculation at Status Date
testCases.objective: Verify that incomplete critical path activities at the status date trigger delay flags and calculate forecast finish date.
executionSteps: 2. Evaluate percentComplete vs planned completion at status date.
3. Project cascading finish date based on remaining duration.
testCases.expectedResult: Activity ACT-005 flagged with +9 working days slip; forecast project finish shifts to 2027-03-09.
testCases.actualResult: ACT-005 delayed with +9 days slip; forecast finish date calculated as 2027-03-09.

testCases.title: Earned Value Indicators & Threshold Warning Alerts
testCases.objective: Programmatically calculate PV, EV, AC, CV, SV, CPI, SPI, EAC, and VAC, and fire threshold warnings when CPI/SPI drop below 0.85.
testCases.expectedResult: CV = -620,000 PKR, SV = -620,000 PKR, CPI = 0.782, SPI = 0.842, EAC = 6,410,256 PKR, 2 warnings triggered.
testCases.actualResult: CV: -620,000, SV: -620,000, CPI: 0.782, SPI: 0.842, EAC: 6,410,256, 2 active threshold alerts returned.

testCases.title: Division by Zero AC Protection
testCases.objective: Ensure system handles projects with zero logged expenditures (AC = 0) gracefully without throwing NaN, null pointer, or crashing.
testCases.preconditions: Fresh project with no cost entries logged.
executionSteps: 2. Check CPI output and system stability.
testCases.expectedResult: Returns cpi: null with cpiReason: 'No expenditure logged yet' without throwing NaN.
testCases.actualResult: cpi: null, cpiReason: 'No expenditure logged yet', no crash or NaN.

testCases.title: 5x5 Risk Matrix Scoring (Likelihood x Impact) & Ranking
testCases.objective: Quantify risk severity by Likelihood x Impact (1 to 25 scale) and assign correct color bands (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH).
testCases.preconditions: Risk register with varied L and I scores.
executionSteps: 2. Assign score >= 15 as HIGH (Red), >= 8 as MEDIUM (Amber), < 8 as LOW (Green).
testCases.expectedResult: Risk 1 (Score 15, HIGH) ranked #1, Risk 2 (Score 12, MEDIUM) ranked #2, Risk 3 (Score 2, LOW) ranked #3.
testCases.actualResult: Score 15 (HIGH), Score 12 (MEDIUM), Score 2 (LOW); correctly prioritized in order.

testCases.title: PDPC Tree Structure Generation with Dual Action Branches
testCases.objective: Verify generation of hierarchical PDPC tree linking High-level Goal -> Risk Event -> Preventive Action Branch -> Corrective Contingency Branch.
testCases.preconditions: High-risk item RSK-001 with both preventive and corrective actions defined.

testInputs.risk: Hospital network fiber cut during municipal maintenance
testInputs.preventive: Configure automatic secondary cellular 4G/5G failover tunnels
testInputs.corrective: Enable local SQLite cache on reception desks with delayed sync

executionSteps: 2. Validate node types: Goal, Problem, Preventive, Corrective.
3. Verify directional edges connect Goal -> Problem -> Actions.
testCases.expectedResult: Returns valid directed tree with 4 node levels and dual contingency leaves.
testCases.actualResult: Generated tree with Goal, Problem, Preventive (blue leaf), and Corrective (purple leaf) nodes and edges.

testCases.title: Triple-Constraint Impact Snapshot Simulation (CR-001)
testCases.objective: Simulate scope, schedule, and cost deltas before CCB approval, flagging budget cap overrun (+800k over PKR 5.0M).
executionSteps: 3. Calculate revised finish date = 2027-02-20 + 15 working days = 2027-03-09.
testCases.expectedResult: Returns frozen impact comparison: revisedBudget: 5,800,000 PKR, budgetCapExceeded: true, revisedDeadline: 2027-03-09.
testCases.actualResult: revisedBudget: 5800000, budgetCapExceeded: true, revisedDeadline: '2027-03-09', deltaSummary verified.

testCases.title: Charter Retrieval & Approved Budget Verification
testCases.objective: Verify GET /api/project returns persistent charter details, objectives, stakeholders, and approved budget of PKR 5,000,000.
testCases.preconditions: Database seeded with case study data.
testCases.actualResult: HTTP 200 returned, approvedBudget: 5000000, status: 'Executing', stakeholders count: 4.

testCases.title: Scope Gate Enforces Rejection of Unapproved Requirements in WBS
testCases.objective: Verify server rejects attempt to link a WBS node to an unapproved requirement (status = 'Proposed') with HTTP 422.
executionSteps: 1. Send POST /api/wbs with unapproved requirement ID.
2. Expect server middleware to intercept violation.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 422 returned with message: 'Scope Gate Violation: Only Approved requirements can be included in WBS'.
testCases.actualResult: HTTP 422 returned with exact Scope Gate violation error message.

testCases.title: Project Closure Gate Blocks Closure While Critical Defects Remain
testCases.objective: Verify POST /api/project/close refuses project closure if unresolved critical defects exist, returning itemized blockers.
executionSteps: 2. Check governance gate pre-condition checks in projectService.closeProject().
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 422 returned with list of blockers: 'Critical defects still open (DEF-001)' and 'Incomplete activities'.
testCases.actualResult: HTTP 422 returned with itemized blockers preventing unauthorized project closure.

testCases.title: Change Request Impact Simulation Endpoint
testCases.objective: Verify GET /api/change-requests/:id/impact computes and returns before vs after delta comparison.
executionSteps: 3. Verify delta object contains costDelta, scheduleDeltaDays, and baseline comparisons.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 200 returned with costDelta: 800000, scheduleDeltaDays: 15, revisedFinishDate: '2027-03-09'.
testCases.actualResult: HTTP 200 returned with exact impact projection matching case study expectations.

testCases.title: CCB Approval Promotes Scope, Recalculates Schedule & Creates Baseline v2
testCases.objective: Verify POST /api/change-requests/:id/approve promotes proposed requirements to 'Approved', recalibrates dates, and stores Baseline v2.
executionSteps: 3. Verify Project.baselines contains new 'v2' record with budget 5,800,000 PKR.
testCases.expectedResult: CR status becomes 'Approved', Baseline v2 created in project with budget 5,800,000 PKR.
testCases.actualResult: CR marked Approved, Baseline v2 stored in database with budget 5,800,000 and deadline 2027-03-09.

testCases.title: Multi-Project Creation & Isolation Verification
testCases.objective: Verify GET /api/projects lists existing projects and POST /api/projects creates independent new projects without data collision.
executionSteps: 3. Verify newly created project has code PRJ-DENTAL and isolated data scope.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 201 Created with new project ID; distinct from PRJ-HEALTH.
testCases.actualResult: HTTP 201 Created, project registered with isolated charter, budget 2,000,000 PKR.
